units.source_text: 今上与尼僧三公主有兄妹之谊，对这薰君当然亦甚关心，常常觉得他很可怜。

en.t: Because the reigning Emperor had a brotherly bond with the Third Princess, now a nun, he naturally showed great concern for Lord Kaoru as well, and often felt pity for him.

units.source_text: 明石皇后为了她的几位皇子和薰君一同出生在六条院，从小一起玩耍，故一向对薰君同自己儿子一样看待，至今并不改变。

en.t: Empress Akashi, because her several princes and Lord Kaoru had been born together at Rokujo-in and had played together since childhood, had always treated Kaoru just like one of her own sons, and this had not changed even now.

units.source_text: 源氏生前曾说：“这孩子是我晚年所生，我不能看他长大成人，真堪痛心！”

en.t: During his lifetime, Genji had once said, "This child was born to me in my later years, and it truly pains me that I cannot watch him grow to adulthood."

units.source_text: 明石皇后回想起这话，对薰君关怀更切了。

en.t: When Empress Akashi recalled those words, her care for Lord Kaoru became even deeper.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣对薰君的照顾，比对自己的儿子更加周到，全心全意地抚育他。

en.t: The Minister of the Right Yugiri looked after Lord Kaoru even more attentively than he did his own sons, raising him with all his heart.
